'''Sark''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Technician Sark appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Tatooine Equipment Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock. He was later removed from the game along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Commendations vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
